about_the_game:
🧁 Welcome to Caramel Creek 🍂

Sometimes happiness means leaving everything behind.
In Caramel Creek, you play as someone who’s grown weary of the city grind — the deadlines, the crowds, the constant rush.
With your savings in hand and a heart full of quiet dreams, you pack up and move to the countryside near the picturesque town of Caramel Creek.

🏞️ There, nestled beside the gentle river that shares the town’s name, you find a run-down little house. It’s far from perfect — but full of promise.
And you make a decision: you’ll turn it into a cozy café, a place for city folks, locals, and wanderers alike to gather, rest, and sip something warm.

This is not just a game about coffee — it’s a story of finding your place in the world. Of building something with your own hands. Something that feels like home.

☕ Key Features:

  • 🌱 Grow and brew your own coffee from scratch

  • 🏠 Restore and design your own cozy café

  • 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Befriend (or avoid) the strange townsfolk

  • 🔮 Unravel mysteries hidden beneath the town

  • 📆 Live at your pace — no pressure, no deadlines

  • ✨ Pixel art world inspired by Stardew Valley and Twin Peaks

🎮 Features:

🌅 Explore a living world with dynamic day-night cycles, weather, and changing seasons

☕ Build your café from scratch — from painting the walls to crafting your first espresso

👥 Meet the locals — each with their own story, personality, and routine

🌱 Plant and tend coffee bushes, harvest the beans, and roast them yourself

🛠️ Upgrade your equipment to unlock new recipes and personalize your café

🌳 Decorate the area around your home, plant trees, place decorations, build fences

🐱 Austin the cat roams nearby — your lazy but lovable companion. Find out what actually happened to him

🎵 The game is wrapped in gentle music, warm pixel textures, and the quiet joy of doing things your own way.
Caramel Creek isn’t just a café sim — it’s a personal story. A place where everything belongs to you, from day one.
A world you create, and grow into.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 or higher
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz Dual Core
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 or better
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: Tired of city life, you move to the countryside of Caramel Creek to build a cozy café by the river. Grow coffee, befriend locals, decorate your space, and create a place worth coming back to—every single day!
